# Musical Sprouts

> Toddler and preschool music classes in Collingwood, Ontario — songs, rhythm, and connection for little ones and their grown-ups.

Musical Sprouts offers early childhood music classes at Christ Our Hope Lutheran Church, 9874 Beachwood Rd, Collingwood, ON. Classes run Thursdays and Fridays (40 minutes, max 12 families). Options include a $20 + HST trial, 7-week sessions, and a flexible membership at $25.14 + HST a class (paid 8 classes at a time). Payment is by e-transfer to contactmusicalsprouts@gmail.com.

## Site

- [Home](https://musicalsprouts.com/): Overview, classes, how to book, contact
- [Pricing & registration](https://musicalsprouts.com/pricing): Trial, session, membership, FAQ
- [Sproutlings](https://musicalsprouts.com/sproutlings): Toddler music class, ages 1–3, Thursdays 10:30am
- [Budding Sprouts](https://musicalsprouts.com/budding-sprouts): Preschool music class, ages 3–5, Thursdays 11:15am
- [Sprouts All-Ages](https://musicalsprouts.com/sprouts-all-ages): Family music class, ages 1–5, Fridays 10:30am
- [Blog](https://musicalsprouts.com/blog): Music and the developing brain
- [Contact](https://musicalsprouts.com/contact): Book a free 15-minute call with Kelly, or sign up for class news
